item.title: Blizzard Can't Stop Tweaking WoW: Forever and It's Only Been 6 Days
item.description: While Blizzard has vowed to issue a major balance patch for World of Warcraft: Forever when the retro MMO's raids launch in December, the developer certainly doesn't seem afraid of doing some tinkering under the hood in the meantime. A roundup of hotfixes published on Nov. 10 would put the full patch notes of many live-service games to shame. And we're just six days out from launch.

item.title: Gerudo Proving Grounds walkthrough in Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Gerudo Proving Grounds is an area in Gerudo Fortress where you can test your battle prowess in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

item.title: Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum Officially Wraps Filming
item.description: We are one step closer to seeing a new Lord of the Rings film in theaters. Andy Serkis has confirmed that principal photography on The Hunt for Gollum has been completed, which he is directing in addition to reprising the titular role that made him famous. The movie is currently slated to be released on Dec. 17, 2027.

item.title: Golden Joystick Awards 2026: All the Winners From Today’s Show
item.description: This year's gaming awards season kicks off in earnest today with the 44th annual Golden Joystick Awards . It's an especially interesting event given just how up in the air 2026's Game of the Year race has been. Unlike 2025, which had a clear frontrunner in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , this year's slate of games has been full of quality titles, but nothing has singularly captured the public's interest in a way that assures it will take home awards. The Golden Joysticks could be an early indicator of what games will rise to awards recognition, especially at Geoff Keighley’s The Game Awards in December.

item.title: Ex-Tekken Boss Doesn’t Want Next-Gen Xbox to Repeat Series S Mistake
item.description: It’s no secret that many video game developers aren’t big fans of the Xbox Series S due to its weaker performance compared to other modern consoles. However, ex- Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada made his frustrations very clear during the Console Game Developers Conference in Korea, when he tore down the system in front of a Microsoft official.

item.title: All quiver upgrade locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: The quiver upgrades in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake improve one of Link's best weapons: the Fairy Bow. As adult Link, the bow is your strongest ranged weapon, especially after you have unlocked special types of arrows, such as the Fire Arrow . The only downside to using the bow is that Link carries a limited number of arrows — a drawback that you can solve by finding the right upgrades.

item.title: Huge 'Skyrim' Release Upstages Bethesda On Game's 15th Anniversary
item.description: It's been 15 years since the original release of landmark RPG The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim , and Bethesda is celebrating the occasion with... uh, not much. The game is on sale, there's a raffle for a Skyrim collector's item , and you can download some fan-created and Bethesda-approved minor new content for the game . While the studio is surely busy working on The Elder Scrolls 6 , the game's development progress has quietly disappointed fans as well . The sequel was announced eight years ago, and so far all we've learned is that it's subtitled Sentinel . Worry not, dear reader. While Bethesda has evidently run out of new platforms to port Skyrim , modders are still pushing the best-selling game to new limits.

item.title: Disney Plus Officially Adds New Versions of Several Star Wars Films
item.description: Get your motion sickness pills ready, because Disney is releasing an all-new way to watch over 60 films, including several Star Wars flicks. Disney Plus and Meta have teamed up to offer “3D” versions of several movies through the Meta Quest 3 and 3S headsets.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson Confirms Promising Update on the Mistborn Movie
item.description: Another week means another update from prolific author Brandon Sanderson . One of the best things about the man behind the expansive Cosmere universe of novels is that he is an open book (pun intended) when it comes to giving updates on the many projects he is actively working on. More recently, these weekly dispatches have included news on Apple's live-action adaptations of Sanderson's work. This week was no different.

item.title: Sony Officially Confirms Major PS5 Hardware Sales Milestone
item.description: Hardware sales may be down across the board in the video game industry, but that hasn't stopped Sony from reaching a major new PlayStation 5 sales milestone this year. The multimedia giant achieved its latest impressive sales feat prior to the holiday rush and before the highly-anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto 6 to boot.
